title: NAXA SERVICES — registre exhaustif des 55 points d'émission d'outbox

protocol.event_id: UUID generated once at enqueue; preserve across retries
protocol.site: site_id required for site-scoped operations; null only for explicit org-level operations
protocol.workstation: workstation_id optional and validated when present
protocol.actor: derived from authenticated access token/server membership, never from client-supplied actor as authority
protocol.device: registered installation resolved from authenticated session; persist device-scoped sequence for deterministic ordering
protocol.aggregate: aggregate_type + stable aggregate_id; no raw SQL/table selector
protocol.action: typed allowlisted action; action schema version 1
protocol.payload_hash: canonical hash computed by server after normalization
protocol.receipt: same transaction as business mutation; returned with event_id, action, aggregate ID, server ID/version, hash and applied_at
protocol.conflict: financial/stock/time events are append-only; mutable master data use optimistic version; no last-write-wins for financial facts
protocol.retry: network/timeout/429/5xx exponential backoff with jitter; 4xx validation/scope terminal; missing dependency blocked; never discard unacknowledged event

release_rule: N1 is closed when every source callsite appears exactly once, each row has a classification and contract/disposition, all independent remote mutations define an allowlisted action/payload/scope/dependency/receipt/idempotency/conflict/retry/test set, and all derived/API-mirror/legacy events are explicitly excluded from standalone replay.

current_transport_observations.source_outbox_entity: LocalOutboxEvent stores eventId, orgId, aggregateType, aggregateId, actionCode, payloadJson, deviceSequence, createdAtEpochMs, state, schemaVersion and retry/receipt state. It does not persist an actor ID or installation/device ID on each row; actor/device must be resolved from the authenticated server session and registered installation.
current_transport_observations.source_sequence: NaxaServicesDao.nextOutboxSequence(orgId) calculates MAX(deviceSequence)+1 scoped to orgId in the local database. Since each Android installation has its own local Room database, ordering is local to that installation, but the envelope does not yet carry a device ID. N2/N3 must bind it to the authenticated installation and enforce per-device server uniqueness.
current_transport_observations.org_scope_event: loyalty_program.updated is organization-scoped and intentionally has site_id=null. The bounded SupplierSyncCoordinator currently requires a nonblank site_id, so this organization-level event is not currently transported by that coordinator. Its scope is defined in the registry contract.
current_transport_observations.current_snapshot_coverage: 11 of the 55 outbox call sites use complete action snapshots and correspond exactly to the 11 action codes currently accepted by SupplierSyncCoordinator; the other 44 still use the generic aggregate_id/site_id fallback. Their classification is recorded per call site.
current_transport_observations.authority: The server derives member identity and permissions from the access token. Client-supplied actor labels are descriptive audit payload, never an authorization source.
